=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2376-2389 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1` is prefixed to the shell function call `gh_api_json_to_file`, so the assignment persists in the intake shell after the function returns.
  WHY: Later `gh_retry` writes (source comment, recovery comment/close, label creation, heal issue creation) then run with 1 attempt instead of 5, so a transient failure can lose them. Severity is MAJOR from both reviewers. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagrees and says the prefix is call-scoped in non-POSIX bash.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1507-1510 (also scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:112-122, :121; calls at workflow 1644-1645) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `e2e_note_watched_run` skips duplicates without refreshing their position, so the five-ID cap can evict the still-active Implement run id.
  WHY: Once the active run id is evicted, the later stall or timeout error omits its URL, so heal intake lacks the run evidence this change is meant to expose. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 judged the eviction scenario unlikely and did not report it.
- tests/test_review_semble_contract.py:(no line given) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push test gate reports a failure in the review/autofix contract test suite.
  WHY: The reviewer says this indicates a contract break introduced by the changes.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2376-2389 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: With retries disabled, a single transient 502/503/504 permanently skips a linked run (`reason=run_unreadable`).
  WHY: This contradicts the documented fail-open intent, and the "counts HTTP requests" claim has no retry infrastructure behind it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, Phase 1 Clarify and Phase 2 Plan wait loops and their stall/timeout `::error::` lines (around 1017, 1125, 1316)
  confidence=5

The Clarify and Plan stall/timeout errors at lines 1017, 1125 and 1316 are unchanged, and those loops capture run ids only on success branches that exit 0. === FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2376, 2389 (inside `_heal_collect_linked_runs`, called at line 2432) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 gh_api_json_to_file ...` prefixes a shell function (defined at `scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1375`), so the assignment stays in the calling shell after the function returns.
  WHY: Later `gh_retry` calls (reading `GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-5` at `scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1170` and `:1380`) use 1 attempt: line 2774 `_comment_on_source`, line 2819 `_heal_scope_recovery_finalize`, line 2823 `gh issue close`, and lines 2936/2939 label creation (so the line 2942 `gh issue create` can fail with 422). This degrades every GitHub write in the intake run.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:112-122 and .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1499-1515 (polling at 1644-1645, stall error at 1739) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The duplicate-skip returns early before any position refresh, so after five newer latest-id observations `IMPL_RUN_ID_WORKING` is truncated out of `E2E_WATCHED_RUN_IDS`.
  WHY: The stall `::error::` then omits the actually-running implement run, so heal intake's `extract_run_refs` misses it. The reviewer suggests re-adding duplicates or refreshing position.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2376, 2389 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With retries disabled, a single 502/503/504 permanently skips a linked run (`reason=run_unreadable`) despite the documented fail-open intent.
  WHY: The claim that the cap "counts HTTP requests, not logical reads" has no retry-on-transient infrastructure behind it.
- TASK_GAP: severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Requirement: "The phase wait loops (Phase 1 clarify, Phase 2 plan, Phase 3b implement, Phase 4 review) already hold the scoped run ids they poll"; "When a scoped run id is first seen, and in every stall / timeout `::error::` line, print the watched run URLs."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, Phase 1 Clarify stall/timeout `::error::` lines (around line 1017) and Phase 2 Plan stall/timeout `::error::` lines (around lines 1125 and 1316).
  Evidence of absence: The PR adds watched-run URL output to the Implement and Review waits (workflow lines 1644-1645 and 1739; review script lines 319, 833 and 844) but not to the Clarify or Plan timeouts. Those loops capture run ids only on success branches (lines around 990, 1209 and 1219) that exit 0. The reviewer says the narrowing in `agents.d/8248-heal-intake-linked-runs.md` is more conservative than required, because the dispatch step already returns a run id.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, Phase 1 Clarify and Phase 2 Plan wait loops.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2376, 2389 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1` is prefixed to the shell function `gh_api_json_to_file` (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1375), so the assignment persists in the current shell. The collector runs at top level (workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2432) and nothing later resets the variable.
  WHY: `gh_retry` (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1170) and `gh_api_json_to_file` (gh_helpers.sh:1380) then use 1 attempt instead of 5. Affected writes are the source comment (line 2774), heal-issue creation, label creation and follow-up comments (around lines 2936-2942 and 3181), so a transient failure silently loses them. The fix is to save and restore `GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` around the two reads.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
